name: Polina protiv stalkera
source:
Polina and Nastya made plans for a relaxing vacation, but at one point everything collapsed. An unfamiliar young man made a real shadowing of Nastya, in a couple of days her life turned into a nightmare in reality. Nastya’s salvation is in the hands of Polina. Or rather - in your hands.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230602124716/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=games.noesis.polina]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
波琳娜和纳斯佳计划度过一个轻松的假期，但有一天一切都崩溃了。一个陌生的年轻人对娜斯佳产生了真正的阴影，几天之内，她的生活变成了现实中的噩梦。娜斯佳的救赎掌握在波琳娜手中。或者更确切地说 - 在你的手中。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230602124716/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=games.noesis.polina]Google Play[/url]]
